items.name: tuya_heat_pump
items.description: This project allows you to control and monitor your Tuya cloud-based heat pump device through Home Assistant.

items.name: Hasselblad-X2DII-Extensions
items.description: X2D II extensions / FW 1.3.18.1 experimental: installer + shared runtime, 400MP, multiple exposure, filters and never sleep. 非官方测试版。

items.name: telepy
items.description: Self-hosted web console for machines behind NAT and firewalls: one outbound reverse SSH tunnel per device gives you a browser terminal, files, RDP / VNC / RustDesk desktops, a remote browser and the LAN behind it — shared with fine-grained permissions and scriptable through a CLI, REST API and MCP. Rust + Next.js.

items.name: IntelligenceX
items.description: IntelligenceX is a .NET toolkit for the Codex app-server protocol and a GitHub Actions reviewer. It manages the app-server process, speaks JSON-RPC over JSONL, and ships a CLI/web wizard to onboard review automation quickly and safely.
